summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. V, a Cayman Islands blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing its board elected to extend the deadline to complete a business combination from August 31, 2026 to September 30, 2026. This is the latest in a permitted series of up to four one-month extensions through December 31, 2026. The filing provides no new deal terms, pricing, or counterparty details. The extension is a routine administrative step common to SPACs, not a transaction event. Watch for subsequent extensions or an announcement of a target business combination before the final deadline.
